name: Fitness Tracker
highLevelGoals: The user aims to accurately record and monitor various physical activities, both automatically and manually, to maintain a complete log of their exercise habits.

The user seeks to easily view and understand their fitness progress over time through intuitive reports and visual representations, fostering motivation and insight into their consistency and improvements.
The user desires the ability to set, customize, and track specific fitness goals, allowing them to tailor their targets to their individual fitness level and monitor their achievement status.
The user expects to receive personalized workout suggestions that adapt to their fitness level, preferences, and feedback, ensuring effective and tailored exercise plans.
The user aims for effortless and real-time synchronization of fitness data from their wearable devices to the application, providing accurate and up-to-date information without manual input.
The user wants to easily share their fitness activities, milestones, and progress on social media platforms to celebrate achievements, motivate others, and engage with their network.
lowLevelGoals: The user can start a session where the application automatically detects and records their physical activity.
The user can input details of an activity they performed, which was not automatically tracked.
The user can modify the type, duration, intensity, or other attributes of an activity entry.
The user can access a consolidated view of all activities performed within a single day.
The user can create a report that summarizes their activity data over a week, highlighting trends and key metrics.
The user can see charts and graphs illustrating their progress for selected timeframes (e.g., monthly, quarterly).
The user can define a new objective for their fitness journey with specific parameters.
The user can adjust the parameters of a goal they have already set.
The user can see how close they are to achieving their set goals.
The user gets a suggested workout plan tailored to their past performance and objectives.
The user can rate or comment on a workout suggestion to help the system adapt future recommendations.
The user can ask for a different workout suggestion if the initial one doesn't meet their needs.
The user can pair their fitness tracker or smartwatch with the application.
The user can check if their devices are connected and when data was last transferred.
The user can force an immediate transfer of data from their wearable to the application.
The user can post details of a finished workout or activity to their social media accounts.
The user can post their fitness milestones or overall progress reports to social media.
The user can control who sees their shared activities and achievements on social media.
